author: Gert Marginet
name: CAT CDC mapping
description: The message of a captured table change, the mapping of a CatChange to it and its test, for Cat.Sql.Cdc on SQL Server. The Contracts project needs gmarginet.Cat.Messaging.Abstractions, and the core project gmarginet.Cat.Sql.Cdc.Abstractions and gmarginet.Cat.Messaging.Abstractions. Run it in the folder of the solution of a service.

ServiceName.description: The full name of the service, such as Contoso.Shop.Orders.

Tests.description: Add the test. Use false for a service without the project ServiceName.CoreService.Tests.
